exposure: Removal of user fees for facility-based delivery services
outcome: Proportion of births delivered in facilities
Proportion of births delivered by Caesarean section
cohort: The study analyzed births from Demographic and Health Surveys conducted in 10 sub-Saharan African countries (Kenya, Ghana, Senegal, and seven control countries) between 1997 and 2012.
finding: Removing user fees for facility-based deliveries increased facility-based deliveries and possibly contributed to a reduction in neonatal mortality rates.
mod_finding: There was no evidence of an increase in Caesarean deliveries following the policy change.
country: 10 sub-Saharan African countries (Kenya, Ghana, Senegal, and seven unnamed control countries)
cross-section timing: Data collected from repeated cross-sectional Demographic and Health Surveys between 1997 and 2012
